nodes.title: Join the takes that Mode asks for
Read me
widgets_values:
## h3c Studio: every h3c feature in one graph
MiniMax H3 picture + sound on Apple silicon (h3.c, Metal). Runs outside ComfyUI's latent graph: no LoRA, SLA or latent upscale here, and nothing else H3 may be loaded while it runs.

**Mode** is the control panel. It switches the inputs on or off; switched-off loaders never run.
- text to video: prompts only
- first frame / first + last frame: anchors take 1 (use takes = 1 for a classic first-to-last clip)
- references: Picture 1 identity, cited in the prompt as <Picture 1>
- continue_clip: take 1 continues the clip on the left instead of starting fresh
- takes: 1 to 3. Each later take continues the one before (last 22 frames + 0.9 s of sound) and adds about 6 s of new picture. Takes past this number never render.

Picture 2, Video 1 and Audio 1 are extra ordered references with their own switches (off by default).

**Measured** (M5 Pro 48 GB, 544x960, 8 steps): about 7.5 min for a 5 s first take, about 9 min per 7 s continuation. Join between takes r 0.993.

Write each continuation so it opens on the state the take before ended in.
